title: Sales are Booming for Applied Materials | AMAT Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc asks whether Applied Materials is a buying opportunity after AI-driven demand surged. Management forecasts 2027 as another year of 30% demand growth, plans to double system output from Q4 2026 levels by 2028, and more than double manufacturing capacity by 2030. Wall Street expects 31% EPS growth per year, the most optimistic outlook since the early 2020s. Operating margin has risen to over 31% (from ~23% a decade ago) alongside the revenue growth, which he reads as evidence of genuine organic demand - unlike Mercado Libre or Palo Alto Networks, where growth comes with margin pressure. The balance sheet can fund the expansion: over $9.2bn in cash and short-term investments against under $6bn in long-term debt. Valuation is mixed: the forward P/E has fallen back to ~15 (where it started 2026) despite a much stronger business, roughly half the expected EPS growth rate, which looks attractive - but his DCF fair value is $357, barely below the ~$370 current price. Verdict: BUY, but low conviction, because the two valuation methods disagree.
